site.name: Yim Rock Tour
site.tagline: Yunnan climbing guides — trips for climbers
site.description: Guided rock climbing tours across Yunnan, China. Sandstone trad at Liming, big-cave sport at Getu, bouldering and alpine exploration. Bilingual guides, tailored trips for experienced climbers and beginners.

home.hero.titleTail: On the walls of southwest China.
home.hero.subtitle: We're a small crew of guides based full-time on the Yunnan plateau. We take climbers to Liming's red sandstone, Getu's cave, and the places that shouldn't only exist as forum threads.
home.courses.title: Want to climb this yourself?
home.courses.body: The Kunming climbing courses with Coach Chen Yimin — four tiers from top-rope to leading trad, bridging the gap between gym and real rock.

home.about.title: A wall isn't just a destination.
home.about.body: A small crew of guides based full-time in Yunnan. We know these walls, the seasons, and the people around them — and we know the best climbing usually happens on an unfamiliar wall.

about.title: About Yim Rock Tour
about.body: We believe the best climbing happens on unfamiliar walls. Yim Rock Tour started in Yunnan and focuses on bringing climbers to the best crags in southwest China.
contact.title: Get in touch
contact.body: Interested in a tour, or looking for a custom trip? Send us a note with your goals and dates.
